Oyster Boy Dringo works at the kennel outside Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington during Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Dringo is an apprentice to  Angry Mar'hyah, who often verbally abuses him. He remains in his position because his dad thinks she will 'toughen him up'. He also heavily implies that she has used 'the rod' to discipline both him and the dogs.

If the party summon  Scratch to the kennel, Dringo is overjoyed to see him again. Should the party leave Scratch with Mar'hyah, Dringo promises to take good care of him. However, if the interacting party member successfully passes a  DC 18 Intimidation Check or  DC 18 Persuasion Check to convince Mar'hyah to allow Scratch to stay with them, Dringo mentions that she has a history of abusing all dogs, not only Scratch.

The interacting party member can tell Dringo that they only care about Scratch, or they can attempt to pass a  DC 18 Deception Check or  DC 20 Intimidation Check against Mar'hyah. Failing the checks causes her to fire Dringo, forcing him to permanently leave the kennel, at which point Dringo will disappear and never return. Succeeding the check results in her leaving the kennel while Dringo releases all the dogs from their cages. He vows to care for them better than she ever did.
